title: chore: bump objectui to 6164366619a1 (ADR-0047 interface-page column fix)
body:
Bumps the pinned `@object-ui/console` SHA so the framework's prebuilt `/_console/` SPA picks up:

- **objectui#1684** — the fix for the empty-grid bug: ADR-0047 interface pages rendered only the row-number column when the referenced default view was served hollow (columns live only in named views). Now falls back to object-derived columns, matching ObjectView.
- #1680 / #1681 / #1682 — toolbar visualization dropdown, `uf_*` URL filter persistence, and the lookup quick-filter e2e, all merged after the previous pin (`76c38108544d`).

`packages/console/dist` is gitignored and rebuilt at publish via `scripts/build-console.sh`; this PR only moves the tracked `.objectui-sha` pointer (the established `chore: bump objectui` cadence). I ran the build script locally at this SHA — clean, 33 MB dist, new bundle hash.
